# War Scroll Column 11 — The EMET Bible (Literal)
**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** 1QM (Cave 1), Col. 11 | **Condition:** complete

---

**11:1** You are a terri[ble] God in-the-glory of-Your-kingdom, and-the-congregation of-Your-holy-ones is in-our-midst for-eternal aid. We shall set contempt upon kings, scorn and-mockery upon

**11:2** mighty-men. For the-Lord is holy, and-the-King of-Glory is with-us, together-with the-holy-ones. Warriors of-the-angelic-host are among-our-muster,

**11:3** and-the-Hero-of-War is in-our-congregation; the-host of-His-spirits is with our-steps. And-our-horsemen come like-clouds

**11:4** and-like dew-mist covering the-earth, and-like a-torrent-of-rain showering justice upon-all her-growth. Arise, O you

**11:5** who-lie-in-the-dust! O worms of-the-dead, raise-yourselves to-meet [...] Gird yourselves and-stand! For who is-like-Your-people Israel whom-You-chose

**11:6** for-Yourself from-all the-peoples of-the-lands? A-people of-holy-ones of-the-covenant, instructed in-the-Torah, wise in-understanding,

**11:7** who-hear the-voice of-the-Honored-One and-see the-angels of-holiness, whose-ear is opened; who-hear deep-things and-see the-plan of-

**11:8** the-ages-of-eternity. We-shall direct our-contempt at-kings, mockery and-scorn at-mighty-men. For the-Lord

**11:9** is holy and-the-King of-Glory is with-us, together-with the-holy-ones. Valiant-warriors of-the-angelic-host are among our-numbered-ones, and-the-Hero

**11:10** of-War is in-our-congregation; the-host of-His-spirits is with-our-steps. Our-horsemen come like-clouds and-like dew-

**11:11** mist to-cover the-earth, like a-torrent of-rain showering justice on-all her-growth. For the-God of-Israel has-called

**11:12** a-sword against all the-nations, and-by the-holy-ones of-His-people He-will-do mightily. Arise, O-Hero! Take

**11:13** Your-captives, O-Glorious-One! Gather Your-spoil, O-Worker of-valor! Set Your-hand upon-the-neck of-Your-enemies

**11:14** and-Your-foot upon the-heaps of-slain. Strike the-nations, Your-adversaries, and-let Your-sword devour

**11:15** guilty flesh. Fill Your-land with-glory and-Your-inheritance with-blessing; an-abundance-of-cattle in-Your-territory,

**11:16** silver and-gold and-precious-stones in-Your-palaces. O Zion, rejoice greatly! Shine-forth with-songs-of-joy,

**11:17** O Jerusalem! Exult, all-you cities-of-Judah! Open your-gates perpetually that-the-wealth of-the-nations may-be-brought to-you, and-their-kings shall-serve-you, and-all your-oppressors bow-down before-you, and-the-dust of-your-feet they-shall-lick. To-You belongs the-dominion, and-in-Your-hand is the-battle of-all.

---

*EMET notes: Column 11 is the great thanksgiving hymn celebrating God's power in battle. Hyphenated construct chains preserved throughout. "Hero of War" (gibbor milchamah) retained literally. "Dew-mist" renders Hebrew tal. The column repeats key phrases (11:1-4 echoed in 11:8-11), characteristic of liturgical composition. Final lines echo Isaiah 60.*
